cases.title: Companies House direct registry-result scrape
cases.task: Retrieve a public registry result page and preserve the target company name, number, status/date, and address context.
cases.prompt: Extract OpenAI-related UK company search results, especially OPENAI UK LTD, company number 14367667, incorporation date, and address.
cases.difficulty: Registry result page with repeated near-match company names; quality means isolating the intended entity, not just returning many characters.

cases.title: Basel-Stadt council protocol listing
cases.task: Retrieve a civic-protocol listing and preserve links or labels that would let a reporter reach meeting records.
cases.prompt: Extract Basel-Stadt Grosser Rat protocol listings, dates, and document/PDF links relevant to council monitoring.
cases.difficulty: Scoutpost-style civic source: a listing page where usefulness depends on finding records and document links, not summarizing prose.

cases.title: Zurich Gemeinderat session and protocol listing
cases.task: Retrieve the council session listing and preserve session, agenda, and protocol evidence.
cases.prompt: Extract Zurich Gemeinderat session listings with dates, Traktanden/Protokoll references, and the Sitzungskalender link for civic monitoring.
cases.difficulty: Civic source from the Scoutpost benchmark family; the session table itself is JS-rendered, so scoring rewards tools that at least preserve the server-rendered session/calendar context. URL and probes refreshed 2026-07-03 after the old /protokolle path started returning 404.

cases.title: Lausanne Conseil communal séances and ordres du jour page
cases.task: Retrieve the French-language council séance page and preserve the séance/agenda source trail.
cases.prompt: Extract Lausanne Conseil communal séance calendar information, ordre du jour context, and document links for civic monitoring.
cases.difficulty: French civic source whose séance listing is JS-rendered; the scraper must retain the real page context and not collapse it into generic municipality chrome. URL and probes refreshed 2026-07-03 after the old seances-et-pv.html path started returning 404 — the old weight-2 'PV' probe was also a false positive on the 404 page because the URL slug contains 'pv'.
